title: Chart phase 1 (crypto, first): Lightweight Charts on the Bybit public v5 WebSocket in the browser, with signal/order/fill/bracket markers; /ws/market stops fetching *USDT candles
note: Step T3a of docs/plans/UI-TWO-SURFACE-DESIGN-2026-11.md § 4.3/§ 5.1 (operator U3, 2026-11-05 ~00:36Z: "Full library, but in phases so that we get crypto live fast").
